Far from help

  • Up to 22 min one way (NASA, 2022)
  • Blackouts: days to months (NASA, 2022)
  • The crew must measure and act alone
Source: NASA Technical Reports Server, ASCEND 2022 paper "Communication Delays, Disruptions, and Blackouts for Crewed Mars Missions" · ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/20220013418
